title: WorkspaceGroupCreate
description: Request body for creating a new workspace group.

name.description: Human-readable name for the new workspace group.

regionID.description: Cloud provider region where the workspace group will be deployed.

firewallRanges.description: CIDR IP ranges permitted to connect to workspaces in this group. Use 0.0.0.0/0 to allow all traffic.

allowAllTraffic.description: When true, allows all inbound traffic to workspaces in this group.

adminPassword.description: Initial administrator password for the workspace group database. Must meet SingleStore password complexity requirements.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp after which the workspace group will be automatically terminated.
